spine.deviation_notes: Minor drift: the freeze->Snipe interaction is a cross-skill setup (Ice Shot freezes, Snipe cashes the frozen-target bonus) that the engine models as two independent skills + a GEOMETRY_COLLAPSE door rather than a first-class 'bonus-vs-frozen' coupling; the player keeps the freeze-then-burst rhythm. Mirage Deadeye's clone-echo (repeat-my-attack) collapses to a self_buff+linked-cast trigger rather than spawned autonomous clones -- the 'my shots get doubled by ghosts' fantasy reads as a linked-cast proc. Both are recognizable-but-slightly-hollow, not identity-breaking.

skills.delivery_notes: channeled single-target bow shot; releases one powerful projectile on charge completion (point footprint) -> single_target. Snipe delivers massive bonus damage to FROZEN targets (freeze-shatter-adjacent burst; the freeze is applied by Ice Shot, not Snipe). water register (cold/Ice Shot theming; corpus elem_raw=cold). Rooted/channel commit during the charge.

fires one primary projectile which on impact unleashes 9 shard projectiles in a small spread -> multi_projectile (shotgun/volley phrase-book). This is the FREEZE applicator that sets up Snipe. water (cold). freeze+chill attested via freeze/shatter loop. The 9-shard fanout is the impact stage; primary-shot->fanout is a two-stage geometry (addendum C.4) -- the shard spread is the every-3-seconds map-clear shape, dominant per 7.2.

meta-skill: places clones nearby that repeat the triggering ranged attack at 50% damage for 4-5s -> R-M9 (trigger-chassis meta-skill -> self_buff + trigger_grammar). The clones are a proxy-echo of the player's own ranged attack, not an independent minion loop; consequence lives in trigger_grammar (on-cast-linked -> linked-cast).

mapping_json.motion_frame: Ice Shot to freeze the pack, then channel Snipe for massive burst on frozen targets; Mirage Deadeye clones echo the ranged attack for 4-5s. Boss rotation: Tornadoes -> Ice Shot freeze -> Barrage -> Snipe.

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: GX-11 (corpus gx). Deadeye ascendancy -> t4 via main-law 5 (R-M1): Called Shots (auto-Mark) + Bullseye (crit-vs-marked) route the mark/proxy identity -> PROXY_ASCENSION for the Mirage clone echo; GEOMETRY_COLLAPSE routes the freeze->Snipe conc-burst. chain_count=3 per R-M2 (>=3 load-bearing actives: Ice Shot freeze-setup + Snipe finisher + Mirage Deadeye meta). freeze+chill kept (fetched: 'Snipe is used specifically for frozen enemies'; Ice Shot is the freeze applicator). Mirage Deadeye = R-M9 meta-chassis (self_buff + trigger_grammar), NOT a proxy minion loop -> element-neutral. water single-slot (cold register); no secondary element attested (Lightning Arrow is a distinct variant, not this kit). shock NOT emitted (never named for this kit, S0). Two-stage Ice Shot geometry (primary->9 shards) noted per addendum C.4; dominant loop = shard fanout.
